researchQuestion: Does removing the strict BTC weekly-up gate reveal earlier alt breadth or dated-Fed-flow warnings in 2024-26, without treating increased alarm frequency as predictive proof?
identicalPopulation: ALL 138 v8.11 completeCasePanel rows with 13wk fully observed outcomes; no change in eligibility or dates. Already in NON-EXPANSION structural confirmed BTC state; previous H4.1 five consecutive no-gap check. No use of rows censored after 2026-07-12.

definitions.B: ETH relative to BTC 30-day >0 and >=4/6 original alts outperformed BTC, independent of A
definitions.C: 4-release dated Fed liquidity proxy delta (assets - TGA - total reverse repos) >0, independent of A
definitions.D: B AND C, independent of A
definitions.E: B OR C, independent of A
definitions.F: A OR (B AND C), complementary warning
definitions.baseline: No signal: all eligible comparable rows; common base rate for each target

targets.expansion: Price-derived structural EXPANSION confirmed within next 13 full Sunday closes; NOT a true exogenous bull cycle label
targets.drawdown: BTC next 13w worst DAILY fixing close <= -20% from Sunday t

metrics: Same cohort 138: TP FP FN TN precision recall specificity balanced accuracy for expansion and positive13w
Risk: alarm count, share with adverse>=20% and median 13w returns; do not interpret subset p as real forecasts
Disjoint 2020–23 vs 2024–26 pre-known stratification, note cohorts historically inspected
Fixed nonoverlap anchors: select every 13th COMMON eligible Sunday starting with earliest one, not selected alarms
Positive and negative control: compare C macro UP to inverse DOWN and B breadth to inverse NOT_BROAD; no optimized scoring

Event-level: for six original 2020–24 confirmed expansion switches reported by v8.11, use only 13 weeks preceding each expansion confirmation and count if any warning, count first date, median lead; caution repeated overlapping events

Weekly vs event: count consecutive alarm weeks in each model as one episode; for outcomes score entry Sunday only when future 13wk complete; this avoids presenting 13 consecutive alarms as 13 independent predictions
